words.meaning: The clear sky; the upper regions of space beyond the clouds, often associated with stars and dreams.
words.sentence1: The astronomer gazed up at the aether, wondering about distant galaxies. (The astronomer gazed up at the upper sky, wondering about distant galaxies.)
words.sentence2: In his dreams, he soared through a glowing aether of purple and gold. (In his dreams, he soared through a glowing upper space of purple and gold.)

words.meaning: A daydream, reverie, or a fantasy that resembles a dream.
words.sentence1: Miraba las estrellas en un profundo ensueño. (She looked at the stars in a deep reverie.)
words.sentence2: Su vida parecía un hermoso ensueño bajo el cielo nocturno. (Her life seemed like a beautiful daydream under the night sky.)

words.meaning: A sparkling, twinkling, or glittering light, much like starlight.
words.sentence1: Le scintillement des étoiles illuminait la nuit claire. (The twinkling of the stars illuminated the clear night.)
words.sentence2: Il aimait observer le scintillement lointain des galaxies. (He loved to observe the distant sparkle of the galaxies.)

words.meaning: A constellation of stars that forms an imaginative picture in the night sky.
words.sentence1: Wir suchten am Nachthimmel nach unserem Lieblingssternbild. (We looked for our favorite constellation in the night sky.)
words.sentence2: Jedes Sternbild erzählt eine alte Geschichte aus grauer Vorzeit. (Every constellation tells an ancient story from the distant past.)

words.meaning: A phantom, vision, illusion, or something dreamlike that vanishes.
words.sentence1: Hoshizora no naka de sore wa maboroshi no you ni mieta. (In the starry sky, that looked like a phantom.)
words.sentence2: Utsukushii yume wa asa ni naru to maboroshi ni kawaru. (A beautiful dream turns into an illusion when morning comes.)

words.meaning: A shimmer, gleam, or glitter of light.
words.sentence1: Il luccichio delle stelle guidava i viaggiatori nel buio. (The shimmer of the stars guided the travelers in the dark.)
words.sentence2: C'era un magico luccichio nei suoi occhi quando parlava dei suoi sogni. (There was a magical gleam in her eyes when she spoke of her dreams.)

words.meaning: Starlight; the light emanating from the stars.
words.sentence1: Tā zài xīngguāng xià jìnlù le zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng. (She confided her dreams under the starlight.)
words.sentence2: Wēnróu de xīngguāng zhào liàng le hēiàn de yèwǎn. (The gentle starlight illuminated the dark night.)

words.meaning: Starlight; the luminescence cast by stars in the night sky.
words.sentence1: Bamhaneurui byeolbit-i chorohage bichnago isseotda. (The starlight in the night sky was shining brilliantly.)
words.sentence2: Geuneun byeolbit-eul barabormyeo gipeun kkum-eulkkueotda. (He looked at the starlight and dreamed a deep dream.)

words.meaning: To shine gently, radiate a soft glow, or glisten like distant stars.
words.sentence1: Tarika phoeun phorng banluch nyu pka pek nakee. (The stars shined brightly lighting up the dark night.)
words.sentence2: Sopheap chol chet smal tarika phoeun knong kncheak kpeu. (Sopheap loves watching the stars gleam in the sky.)

words.meaning: Starlight; the light that comes from the stars.
words.sentence1: Ons het onder die helder sterrelig gesels oor ons drome. (We chatted under the bright starlight about our dreams.)
words.sentence2: Die sterrelig het oor die stille landskap geval. (The starlight fell across the quiet landscape.)
